centor_items.item: History of fever or temperature above 38 C

centor_note: Modified Centor 2 of 4 (no age modifier at 15 to 44). Centor is never stated in a note. The prior used for the target is the unstratified prevalence among adults tested (259/1216), which is a plausible pretest probability for an equivocal presentation. The clinician line (group A streptococcal pharyngitis among the considerations) is a deliberate realism fact, identical across conditions and polarities.
surface_key_note: Surface keys: V, N, B, S, or NB (N and B), NBS. First string is what the templates render; any string counts for the check. Matching is case-insensitive.
